proposal.summary: A path traversal vulnerability in NimbusDocs' file download endpoint allows reading arbitrary files, demonstrated by reading /etc/passwd.
proposal.cwe_quote: Path traversal in the file download endpoint of NimbusDocs lets me read /etc/passwd.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Validate the issue by reproducing the requested download with traversal sequences, identify vulnerable code path, and implement input validation / canonicalization and restrict file access to an allowed directory.
